heroHeadline: FIFA Confirms Three Candidates for March Presidential Election: Infantino, Diallo, Tashima
heroSubtitle: FIFA received three candidatures for the March 18, 2027 vote in Rabat; Ramon Vega was left off. All face eligibility checks, and Diallo says he will talk with Tashima about joining forces.
